_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/workspaces.json (local-only, never committed). hooks/workspace-context.js turns the entry matching the session cwd (longest path wins) into one `ALM:` context line and pins the az identity. Keys: path, platform (azure-devops | github), org, project (a name or "ask") or projects (first subfolder -> project; a subfolder not listed is resolved against the org's project list, else asked), identity (suffix of the private Azure CLI config dir ~/.azure-<identity>), account (who items are assigned to), note (appended verbatim).

roots.note: no work items, no hours on a board: hours go on <github-root>\<project>-time.md
hours before the move stay on <github-root>\<moved-project>-time.md
